description: Compare each entry service date with its posting date against a period cutoff, and total what is in the wrong period. Reports work done before the cutoff and posted after it, which understates the period unless an accrual puts it back, and an amount posted inside the period for later service, which overstates it. An entry with no service date is reported as undeterminable rather than assumed to belong where it was posted. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

entries.description: The entries to judge. Nothing is fetched and no system is connected, so the data supplied is the whole input.

amount.description: The amount. A decimal string is preferred, because a JSON number cannot hold most two-place decimals exactly and the digits may already differ from what was written by the time they arrive. A number is accepted and that risk is reported.

posted_on.description: When it landed in the books. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

service_on.description: When the service happened, which is what decides the period it belongs to. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

grace_days.description: How long after the cutoff a late posting is reported under its own code, since some lateness is expected. Defaults to 0.

period_end.description: The cutoff. Entries are judged against it. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

require_service_date.description: Report an entry with no service date as a finding rather than a note. Defaults to true.

name: accrual_cutoff_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consistent.description: True only when every entry had a service date and every one was posted in the period its service date implies.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

misstated_as_number.description: The same figure as a number, only when it round-trips to the identical exact value.

misstated_total.description: The exact total sitting in the wrong period, which is the figure a cutoff review is looking for.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Accrual Cutoff Audit
